title.en: EVE Academy – Getting Started with Missions

blocks.en: Working with agents and completing missions
blocks.zh: 为代理人工作、完成任务

blocks.en: can earn you valuable income and standing with a corporation.
blocks.zh: 能为你赚取可观的收入，并提升你在军团中的声望（Standing）。

blocks.en: As you earn standing,
blocks.zh: 随着声望提高，

blocks.en: you will unlock more difficult missions
blocks.zh: 你会解锁难度更高的任务，

blocks.en: and earn pay to upgrade your ship to take those challenges on.
blocks.zh: 也能赚到钱来升级舰船，迎接这些挑战。

blocks.en: Missions are available via NPC corporation agents.
blocks.zh: 任务由 NPC 军团的代理人（Agent）发布。

blocks.en: you can locate an agent to work with by opening the Agency window,
blocks.zh: 打开代理机构（Agency）窗口，就能找到可以合作的代理人：

blocks.en: clicking the "Agents and Missions" tab
blocks.zh: 点击「代理人与任务（Agents and Missions）」标签页，

blocks.en: and selecting "Mission Agents".
blocks.zh: 然后选择「任务代理人（Mission Agents）」。

blocks.en: Missions are available in 3 basic types:
blocks.zh: 任务分为 3 种基本类型：

blocks.en: Security, which primarily focus on combat,
blocks.zh: 安全类，以战斗为主；

blocks.en: Distribution, which primarily focus on the transport of goods,
blocks.zh: 物流类，以运送货物为主；

blocks.en: and Mining which focus on resource acquisition by mining asteroids.
blocks.zh: 采矿类，主要是开采小行星获取资源。

blocks.en: Feel free to choose any type that interests you
blocks.zh: 选你感兴趣的类型就好，

blocks.en: for this video, we will be selecting Security Agents.
blocks.zh: 本视频中我们选择安全类代理人。

blocks.en: The next screen will show all agents which are currently available to you
blocks.zh: 下一个界面会列出你当前可用的所有代理人。

blocks.en: more advanced, and lucrative, agents can be unlocked
blocks.zh: 更高级、报酬更丰厚的代理人

blocks.en: as you gain standing with a corporation.
blocks.zh: 需要提升你在军团中的声望才能解锁。

blocks.en: note that for each agent you can see their system and its security status,
blocks.zh: 注意，每个代理人都会显示所在星系及其安全等级，

blocks.en: their corporation and their level.
blocks.zh: 以及所属军团和代理人等级。

blocks.en: Higher level agents pay more generously,
blocks.zh: 等级越高的代理人报酬越丰厚，

blocks.en: but the missions they offer are more challenging
blocks.zh: 但他们发布的任务也更有挑战性，

blocks.en: and require progressively larger and tougher ships to complete.
blocks.zh: 需要越来越大、越来越强的舰船才能完成。

blocks.en: Agents in lower security areas are also more lucrative
blocks.zh: 低安全等级区域的代理人报酬也更高，

blocks.en: than agents of the same level in higher security space,
blocks.zh: 比高安区同等级的代理人更赚钱，

blocks.en: but you'll be at increased risk of being attacked by other players.
blocks.zh: 但你遭到其他玩家攻击的风险也会增加。

blocks.en: Select an agent that interests you and click "Set Destination"
blocks.zh: 选一个你感兴趣的代理人，点击「设为目的地（Set Destination）」，

blocks.en: Then undock and make your way to meet your new agent.
blocks.zh: 然后离站，前往与新代理人会面。

blocks.en: When you arrive at your agent's station,
blocks.zh: 到达代理人所在的空间站后，

blocks.en: locate them in the Agent panel from the station menu
blocks.zh: 在空间站菜单的代理人面板中找到他，

blocks.en: and click the speech bubble to start a conversation.
blocks.zh: 点击对话气泡开始交谈。

blocks.en: This will open the Agent Conversation window,
blocks.zh: 这会打开代理人对话窗口，

blocks.en: where the agent will give you details about the mission you are being offered
blocks.zh: 代理人会在这里向你介绍他提供的任务详情。

blocks.en: Make careful note of any locations mentioned or items required on this screen.
blocks.zh: 请仔细记下此界面上提到的地点或需要的物品。

blocks.en: If you're feeling confident
blocks.zh: 如果你有信心，

blocks.en: click Accept to start the mission.
blocks.zh: 就点击「接受（Accept）」开始任务。

blocks.en: Note that you must complete the mission within a certain time to receive the reward
blocks.zh: 注意，必须在限定时间内完成任务才能获得奖励，

blocks.en: and if you complete it fast enough you may even receive bonus rewards.
blocks.zh: 如果完成得够快，甚至还能拿到额外奖励。

blocks.en: Use the Agent Missions details screen to get to your location
blocks.zh: 利用代理人任务详情界面前往任务地点，

blocks.en: and make sure you've completed all of your objectives.
blocks.zh: 并确认已完成所有目标。

blocks.en: If your mission could involve combat,
blocks.zh: 如果任务可能涉及战斗，

blocks.en: be sure to go prepared to fight!
blocks.zh: 一定要做好战斗准备！

blocks.en: Once you've completed your mission,
blocks.zh: 完成任务后，

blocks.en: speak with your agent again to let them know and collect your rewards.
blocks.zh: 再次与代理人交谈告知他，并领取奖励。

blocks.en: Successfully completing a mission will reward
blocks.zh: 成功完成任务后，

blocks.en: you with ISK and loyalty points (or LP).
blocks.zh: 你会获得 ISK 和忠诚点（LP）。

blocks.en: LP can be exchanged for valuable goods in the corporation's LP store.
blocks.zh: LP 可以在该军团的 LP 商店兑换贵重物品。

blocks.en: You also gain standing with the corporation
blocks.zh: 你还会提升在该军团中的声望，

blocks.en: which can unlock more agents, higher level missions and even better rewards.
blocks.zh: 从而解锁更多代理人、更高等级的任务和更好的奖励。
